correctness.rationale: A source cycle has two neighbours, forcing each target degree to be at most two. Local surjectivity forces a constant-speed map onto a cycle or a fully reflected walk onto a path. The latter has exact period twice the path edge count. Colour preservation is exactly periodicity plus a vertex-axis reflection; pairs of reflection axes differ by a period-constrained half shift. The parity of the fold-to-primitive-period ratio determines whether two centre classes are reversed into each other or stay distinct. Full proof is in RESULT.md, with exhaustive binary/ternary word and independent local-walk checks; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.
